grind coffee beans.name: retrieve coffee bag
grind coffee beans.definition: Open cupboard, take out the coffee beans bag, and place it on the kitchen top.

grind coffee beans.name: measure coffee beans
grind coffee beans.definition: Take the spoon and scoop coffee beans from the bag into the grinder.

grind coffee beans.name: operate coffee grinder
grind coffee beans.definition: Put on the lid and turn on the coffee grinder to grind the beans.

grind coffee beans.name: manage bean packaging
grind coffee beans.definition: Close and seal the coffee beans bag with a clip and store it back.

grind coffee beans.name: empty ground coffee
grind coffee beans.definition: Tilt and shake the grinder or box to pour out the ground coffee.

boil water kettle.name: take kettle
boil water kettle.definition: Pick up the kettle from its base on the kitchen top.

boil water kettle.name: fill kettle with water
boil water kettle.definition: Open the kettle lid, turn on the tap, fill with water, and close the lid.

boil water kettle.name: turn on kettle
boil water kettle.definition: Place the kettle back on its base and turn on the heating switch.

assemble coffee filter.name: position filter and jug
assemble coffee filter.definition: Take the coffee jug and place the V60 filter on top of it.

assemble coffee filter.name: add ground coffee
assemble coffee filter.definition: Scoop and drop ground coffee from the bag or container into the filter.

assemble coffee filter.name: distribute coffee grounds
assemble coffee filter.definition: Shake the filter gently to spread the coffee grounds evenly.

wash coffee cups.name: retrieve cups and jug
wash coffee cups.definition: Open the dishwasher, pull out the rack, and take out the coffee cups and jug.

wash coffee cups.name: wash dishes
wash coffee cups.definition: Use sponge, running tap water, and soap to wash cups, jug, and spoon.

wash coffee cups.name: rinse and dry dishes
wash coffee cups.definition: Rinse off soap with water and dry the items using a cloth.

brew drip coffee.name: lift hot kettle
brew drip coffee.definition: Pick up the boiled kettle from the kitchen top.

brew drip coffee.name: pour hot water
brew drip coffee.definition: Slowly pour water in a rotating motion over the coffee grounds in the filter.

brew drip coffee.name: set aside kettle
brew drip coffee.definition: Put down the kettle on the kitchen top while waiting for the coffee to brew.
